commands.usage: load part of a file to RAM

commands.help:
Usage:  lzma <e|d> <index> Src_Address Src_Length Dst_Address
      e: encode file
      d: decode file
      <index> start to (de)compress position

address count [addr]
    - compute CRC32 checksum [save at addr]

commands.usage: write cis and hash[0-2] for Secure ROM boot
commands.help:
<CISAddr> <PPMAddr> <PNIAddr> <Hash0Addr> <Hash0Size> <MbootAddr> <MbootSize> [<Hash1Size>]
CISAddr   DRAM address of CIS
PPMAddr   DRAM address of PPM
PNIAddr   DRAM address of PNI
Hash0Addr DRAM address of hash0
Hash0Size Total size of the hash0
MbootAddr DRAM address of MbootAddr [Hash1 + Bootram + uboot]
MbootSize Total size of the MbootSize
[Hash1Size Total size of the hash1]

commands.usage: write cis, bootloader and uboot or only CIS for ROM boot
commands.help:
ncisbl CISAddr PPMAddr [PNIAddr] [bootloaderAddr] [bootloaderSize] [ubootAddr] [ubootSize]
  -write CIS, PPM, PNI, bootloader, uboot from those memory address, CISaddr, PPMaddr, bootloaderAddr
	and ubootAddr respectively with 'bootloaderSize' and 'ubootSize' bytes 
	assigned for bootloader and uboot programming.

context_assumptions: Raw BinaryLoader image base 0x8e1efd80 is a command-pointer-derived candidate, not device loader evidence.
MIPS:LE:32:default, default compiler spec; raw memory marked executable only in this new analysis DB.
No whole-program auto-analysis; branch disassembly restricted to 8 KiB per handler; helper functions are not discovered or decompiled.
No gp/t9 values forced; decompiler types/prototypes and unresolved helper names are inferred, not source symbols.
Function boundaries, indirect calls, absolute data references and coverage may be incomplete; no runtime acceptance or signature behavior follows from command names.
